title: Design System: Wheeler Cat — Variant C (display-typography amplification, kinetic-display)

variant.role: different captured trait amplified — display-typography amplification
variant.bet: kinetic-display motion register engaged; palette proportions match A; composition matches A; both static and cinematic renders ship

inherits.compositionInheritFrom: DESIGN-A (palette proportions, band ground assignments, IA, section sequence)

palette.proportions: match variant A (captured proportions); NOT inverted (B is the inverted variant)
palette.catYellowDeployment: CTA + eyebrow + 1px border (captured proportion held — same as A)

composition.note: C inherits A's composition verbatim. The bet is motion, not layout.

motion.registerRationale: PRODUCT.md Brand Personality traits: signage-led ✓, display-typography-signature ✓, wayfinding-first ✓ (partial). Tie-broken against arrival/kinetic-grid/editorial/live-systems per motion-registers.md § Selection heuristic. kinetic-display refuses clause (long fades, decorative serifs, editorial body copy as canvas) does not conflict with any captured trait.

moves.behavior: clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0) → inset(0 0 0% 0) per letter, 120ms letter stagger, 800ms total

moves.target: top-of-page marquee strip below utility bar
moves.behavior: infinite marquee scrolling 'FINANCING DEALS · 0% APR · FUEL PAYBACK · CVA BONUS · SHOP USED', 30s loop
moves.reducedMotionFallback: marquee frozen at initial position; content readable

moves.target: finance numerals 0%, 60 MONTHS, $500 within finance cards
moves.behavior: cycle through random digits 600–900ms before landing on target value with expo ease

moves.target: section heads (YOUR HEAVY MACHINERY EXPERTS, WE PROUDLY SUPPORT THE ONES WHO BUILD OUR WORLD, etc.)
moves.behavior: clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0 0 0 0), 800ms with entrance ease

moves.target: large display copy (hero headline, finance card titles, section heads)

renderOutputs.purpose: static fallback / cinematic-vs-static comparison gate (Pass 6f); reads as variant A composition with no motion declared
visionary pitch surface with kinetic-display register engaged

rejectedMoves: Editorial-register vocabulary (signage vocabulary is the amplified trait)
Mixed motion registers (kinetic-display only; no arrival / editorial / live-systems / kinetic-grid sections)
Decorative-only motion (every move references a captured surface element — headline, numerals, section heads, marquee content)
Long fades (kinetic-display refuses; entrances use hard reveals like wipe, split-flap, blur-resolve)

whatCIsNot: Not 'B with motion'. Palette proportions match A (captured), not B (yellow-surface). C and B differ on both motion AND palette ground.
Not 'more variant A'. C reuses A's composition exactly; the bet is motion.
Not a free-for-all. The register is kinetic-display; moves are bound by the register's signature-moves list and refuses clause.
Not an excuse to skip the reduced-motion fallback. Every move has a static fallback; static render ships alongside the cinematic.

capturedSourceBasis.numericalContent: 0% FOR UP TO 60 MONTHS + $500 TOWARD CVA; stat row 18/75/24; model codes; financing percentages
capturedSourceBasis.wayfinding: embedded Google map + branch list as structural element
